LinkKey is a unique identifier that groups related documents together (e.g., linking an order to its acknowledgement, shipment, and invoice). It ties the full document lifecycle for a single transaction so all related documents can be retrieved and tracked as a unit.

Logicbroker supports multiple test case types for supplier onboarding: Fulfillment (process and fulfill entire order), Cancellation (submit cancellation acknowledgement), Partial Fulfillment/Cancellation (cancel part, fulfill remainder), Return (process return), and Order Change (review and accept retailer changes). Retailers configure which test cases suppliers must complete.
